label: Coder
description: Install the same project inside an existing Coder DDEV freeform workspace.
agents_md: This is the drupalphprust runtime compatibility project, not a migration agent. Read AGENTS.md and .agents/plan/current/README.md before work.
Use DDEV for Composer, Drush and the standard PHP control. PHP Rust runs in the phpr service. No end-to-end compatibility or speed claim has been established.

Runtime contributors: use the bundled DDEV Serena service, connect the selected agent as documented in docs/SERENA.md, and call initial_instructions before Rust editing. Client trust and authentication remain user actions.

questions.label: Are you running locally or on Coder?
Connect Serena to which coding agent?
Where will the agent run? host = this computer or Coder VM; ddev = install inside the web container

replace_welcome_text: Service availability does not certify Drupal compatibility. PHP Rust remains experimental; use the project tracker for evidence and remaining work.
